one_paragraph: The generic per-source execution owner is implemented above one _decode() call and all three named gaps are closed. A GovernedSourceSession owns one broker, one physical open, one aggregate receipt, the decoder-invocation account and a deterministic close, and is reused across every admitted operation in a scope; a typed plan distinguishes METADATA_ONLY, SELECTED, FULL and CHUNKED_FULL as independent operations with encoding now independent of row-data mode, so the previous defect in which a non-null encoding alone forced a full read is fixed and measured. Header-prefix access occurs only when a plan explicitly admits a size. decoder_invocations is a real account and budget counted once at the entry boundary, distinct from reader_invocations, and a second entry is refused with no account movement. The fixture-complete R7 court collects exactly 55 and passes 55/55 twice with exit code 0, the 15 new session courts and the 20 existing broker courts all pass, and the full suite shows zero new failures.

why_this_disposition.because: every element the commission enumerated is present and demonstrated: entry key, path, expected SHA-256, format, reader config, one broker lifecycle, one plan, an aggregate receipt, the decoder-invocations account, and deterministic close on both normal and exceptional paths. All four modes are independently accounted, and the encoding-correction and header-prefix rules are measured rather than asserted.
collect-only is exactly 55 and both required runs passed 55/55 with exit code 0.
zero new failures across the full suite; the existing 20-court broker suite and the SR06 carrier suite are unchanged in behaviour apart from the two pre-existing duckdb absences.
every fixture the commissioned court needed was materialised by this manifest and confirmed present.
the mechanism work is complete and independently requalified; what remains is not a mechanism gap but the authority decisions this lane is explicitly forbidden to make.

requirements_met.one_bound_source_entry_lifecycle: GovernedSourceSession owns it; three plans in one session gave decoder_invocations=3 with path_opens=1
requirements_met.typed_operation_plan_distinguishing_four: METADATA_ONLY, SELECTED, FULL, CHUNKED_FULL, each driving exactly one reader account
requirements_met.encoding_independent_of_row_data_mode: METADATA_ONLY + encoding='latin1' gives metadata 1, selected 0, full 0, chunk 0
requirements_met.header_prefix_only_when_plan_admits: None -> zero prefix reads across three modes; 176 -> exactly one operation of 176 bytes
requirements_met.decoder_invocations_not_reader_invocatio: measured 1 vs 5 on a chunked decode; reader_invocations was not renamed
requirements_met.max_decoder_invocations_1_rejects_second: SOURCE_ACCESS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with all nine tracked accounts unmoved
requirements_met.selected_full_chunked_remain_distinct: each mode asserted to drive its own account and to leave the others at zero
requirements_met.no_SRCxx_policy_hardcoded: court x3 AST-scans code for SRCxx tokens, excluding docstrings; zero found
requirements_met.no_hidden_raw_path_fallback: decode_in_session never constructs a broker or passes a path string; iter_batches still raises rather than falling back
requirements_met.receipt_live_and_complete: built live from the session or broker, so later chunk reads are included
requirements_met.close_source_access_closes_session_safel: closes the session when owned, idempotent, plus context-manager support

what_this_does_not_establish: Source-free only. Qualifies no real survey source and is not survey-semantic equivalence.
No plan is bound to any source. Which plan a given source should carry, and with what header_prefix_bytes, remains for the documentary lanes.
SRC27's historical 'multiple path-level opens' phrase is NOT adjudicated here. This lane supplies only the mechanism by which an admitted prefix size either is or is not read.
The selected route still does not physically suppress unselected-column bytes; the existing disclosure is unchanged.
R9 is not closed by this lane. The architecture-warrant candidate and the authority questions HQ195 recorded remain HQ and Astra decisions.
No adoption, self-adoption, warrant, locator work, live C4, C7 or actor work.
